description: LIVE: cloud and SaaS incidents open right now (AWS, Azure, GCP, Cloudflare, GitHub, Stripe, …), quoted from each provider's own status page with a link, refreshed several times a day. Use for 'is X down', 'why is X failing', or anything after your training cutoff. Filter by provider, region or component instead of reading the whole list; an untracked provider says so rather than returning an empty all-clear. Deterministic: no model in the loop. Prefer it over `answer`.

component.description: Optional. Same matching as region, e.g. 'Actions', 'API'.

provider.description: Optional. Provider name or common alias, e.g. 'AWS', 'gcp', 'GitHub'. 'AWS' matches every AWS service.

region.description: Optional. Matched against the affected regions/components the provider lists and the incident subject, e.g. 'us-east-1'.

name: list_active_incidents
title: Active cloud/SaaS incidents
